weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，你有沒有想過要移動？遙遠的地方和迷人的文化的吸引力可能正在呼喚著你。接受這些外來的影響，可以在你生活的各個方面激發創造力和成長。現在是機會豐富的黃金時刻。如果這個想法讓你感到興奮，請花點時間探索你的選項。在做出任何決定之前，先收集您需要的所有資訊。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, have thoughts of moving been dancing in your mind? The allure of far-off places and intriguing cultures might be calling to you. Embracing these foreign influences could spark creativity and growth in various aspects of your life. Now is a prime moment when opportunities seem abundant. If this idea excites you, take the time to explore your options. Gather all the information you need before making any decisions.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座預計你的家庭生活會有一些令人興奮的發展。親戚可能會來拜訪您，甚至決定與您同住。你可能會發現自己正在重新裝修、整修花園或購買新家具。您也有可能搬遷。無論變化如何，即使過程有點混亂，他們也會帶來積極的結果。迎接未來的旅程，有許多令人興奮的事情！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, anticipate some exciting developments in your home life. A relative might drop by for a visit or even decide to stay with you. You may find yourself engaged in redecorating, enhancing your garden, or shopping for new furnishings. There's also a chance you could be relocating. Regardless of the changes, they are expected to bring positive outcomes, even if the process feels a bit chaotic. Embrace the journey ahead—there's plenty to be excited about!
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，令人興奮的消息可能來自兄弟、姐妹或你附近的人。這可能與財務事宜或在家附近出現的新機會有關。此外，以吸引您的主題為中心的聚會可能即將開始。您可能會發現自己忙著打電話和提前計劃。前景充滿希望，所以要擁抱積極樂觀的態度！
gemini.horoscope_en: Exciting news may be headed your way, Gemini, potentially from a brother, sister, or someone in your neighborhood. This could relate to financial matters or a fresh opportunity emerging close to home. Additionally, a gathering centered around a topic that captivates you might be on the horizon. You may find yourself busy with phone calls and planning ahead. The outlook is promising, so embrace the positivity!
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 今天， Cancer ，你可能會在女性朋友的幫助下找到增加收入的機會。另一種癌症也可能在這個機會中發揮作用。它似乎圍繞著一個獨特的短期項目，既有趣又有經濟回報。你的浪漫伴侶可能也有興趣加入這項事業。在做出決定之前，請花點時間考慮一下。聯絡在類似情況下有經驗的人。 絕對值得探索！
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you may find a chance to boost your earnings, potentially with the help of a female friend. Another Cancer could also play a role in this opportunity. It seems to revolve around a unique, short-term project that could be both fun and financially rewarding. Your romantic partner might be interested in joining the venture as well. Take some time to consider it before making a decision. Reach out to those who have experience in similar situations. It’s definitely worth exploring!
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 今天對你來說是一個新的開始，獅子座。你過去的成就提高了你的自信心，讓你對未來充滿希望和興奮。旅程即將來臨，您可能會找到進一步深造的機會。在浪漫的前線，事情看起來很光明。如果可以的話，你可以用面部護理或按摩來犒賞自己，或者揮霍一些新衣服。 將你的外表與你內心充滿活力的能量對齊，擁抱這個新的篇章。
leo.horoscope_en: Today marks a fresh start for you, Leo. Your past achievements are boosting your self-assurance, filling you with hope and excitement for what lies ahead. There are journeys on the horizon, and you might find opportunities to further your education. On the romantic front, things are looking bright. Treat yourself to a facial or a massage if you can, or perhaps splurge on some new outfits. Embrace this new chapter by aligning your outer appearance with the vibrant energy you feel within.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天是你探索創意一面的絕佳機會。你的想象力在飆升，你對美的眼光特別敏銳。如果你還沒有參與藝術追求，請花點時間在網上搜尋當地課程或工作坊。不妨考慮邀請好友加入你的行列；這可能是一個有趣的體驗！
virgo.horoscope_en: Today is the perfect opportunity for you, Virgo, to explore your creative side if you haven't already. Your imagination is soaring, and your eye for beauty is particularly sharp. If you haven't engaged in artistic pursuits yet, take a moment to search online for local classes or workshops. Consider inviting a friend to join you; it’s likely to be a fun experience!
virgo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會遇到一個可能引發浪漫興趣的人。這種聯繫很可能發生在社交活動或聚會上，在那裡你可以找到即時的融洽關係。期望這個人有魅力、有吸引力、富有同情心，並與他們的情緒保持一致。如果你是單身，對愛情敞開心扉，抓住這一刻！抓住機會探索這段萌芽的關係，誰知道還有什麼美妙的可能性在等著你？
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you may cross paths with someone who could spark a romantic interest. This connection is likely to happen at a social event or gathering, where you'll find an instant rapport. Expect this individual to be charming, attractive, compassionate, and in tune with their emotions. If you're single and open to love, seize this moment! Embrace the opportunity to explore this budding relationship—who knows what wonderful possibilities await?
libra.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，此時你可能會發現自己正處於變化的旋風之中。雖然其中許多轉變是有益的，但轉變的強度可能會讓人感到有點壓倒性。抵制恐慌的衝動；你完全有能力管理好你遇到的一切。逐漸處理每個挑戰，隨著你徵服的每個步驟，前方的道路將變得越來越清晰和容易。相信當你到達目的地時，一切就緒。 繼續前進！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, you may find yourself amidst a whirlwind of changes at this time. While many of these shifts are beneficial, the intensity of the transformation might feel a bit overwhelming. Resist the urge to panic; you are more than capable of managing everything that comes your way. Tackle each challenge gradually, and with each step you conquer, the path ahead will become clearer and easier. Trust that when you reach your destination, everything will fall into place. Stay the course!
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，你可能會發現新的開始和令人興奮的機會即將到來，可能與遙遠的地方或不同的文化有關。你的冒險精神充滿了興奮，但你的一部分渴望穩定，可能會猶豫不決。請記住，並不急於一頭沖進任何東西。花點時間收集所有資訊，並以清晰的頭腦評估情況。深入反思對你來說真正重要的事情。 您最想要的是什麼？
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, you might find that fresh starts and exciting opportunities are on the horizon, possibly linked to a far-off place or a different culture. Your adventurous spirit is buzzing with excitement, yet there's a part of you that craves stability and may hesitate. Remember, there's no rush to dive headfirst into anything. Take your time to gather all the information and evaluate the circumstances with a clear mind. Reflect deeply on what truly matters to you. What is it that you desire the most?
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，突然湧入的金錢可能會為你生活中令人興奮的新機會鋪平道路。您可能會發現自己正在考慮重大變化，例如搬遷到更理想的房源。愛也在空中，如果你目前沒有處於一段關係中，現在可能是探索這種可能性的最佳時機。雖然變革可能令人畏懼，但請放心，這些轉變是積極的。毫不猶豫地擁抱旅程。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, a sudden influx of money could pave the way for exciting new opportunities in your life. You may find yourself contemplating significant changes, such as relocating to a more desirable home. Love is also in the air, and if you're not currently in a relationship, now might be the perfect time to explore that possibility. While change can be daunting, rest assured that these transformations are positive. Embrace the journey without hesitation.
capricorn.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，準備好在你目前的合作夥伴關係中進行一些令人振奮的轉型。如果您參與商業冒險，新的協議即將到來，暗示著成功和繁榮。在內心方面，您的相容性可能會激勵您在關係中向前邁出重要的一步。今天發起的任何新合作都可能富有成效，並與您的願望保持一致。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, get ready for some uplifting transformations in your current partnership. If you're involved in a business venture, a fresh agreement is on the horizon, hinting at success and prosperity. In matters of the heart, your compatibility may inspire you to take a significant step forward in your relationship. Any new collaborations initiated today are likely to be fruitful and align with your aspirations.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你有沒有去健身房、嘗試新的膳食計劃，或者兩者兼而有之？如果是這樣的話，今天你可能會在鏡子中看到一些真實、積極的變化。你可能散發出自信和活力。繼續致力於你的旅程；你所取得的進步值得維持。透過跑步或其他形式的鍛煉來保持這種勢頭，並且不要忘記在之後獎勵自己一點點零食。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, have you been hitting the gym, trying out a new meal plan, or perhaps a bit of both? If that's the case, today might be the day you catch a glimpse of some real, positive changes in the mirror. You're likely radiating confidence and vitality. Stay committed to your journey; the progress you've made is worth maintaining. Keep that momentum going with a run or another form of exercise, and don’t forget to reward yourself with a little treat afterward.
